On Tuesday, March 15, 2016 at 10:25:49 AM UTC-4, Shravan Vasishth wrote:
Could I get the official citation information for the package rstanarm?

I guess the output of

citation("rstanarm")

is good enough for now since there isn't a paper yet. Once there is something more official, we will add a CITATION file so that

citation("rstanarm")

refers to it.

Ben
